mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, id_type, id_no_ciphertext, id_no_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audience_person ( user_id, name, id_type, id_no_ciphertext, id_no_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{idType}, #{idNoCiphertext}, #{idNoHash}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM audience_person WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC
